correctness.rationale: The ambient ordered deleted product DConf(Δ^(n−1),2) is equivariantly homeomorphic via normalized x−y to the unit sphere in the sum-zero R^n hyperplane, dimension n−2. Vertex permutations act by sign and the swap by antipodal degree (−1)^(n−1). Truncating to the codimension-two skeleton removes exactly 2n open top-dimensional cells with first/second support of size n−1 and the other singleton; every lower cell survives. The relative cellular complex is therefore concentrated in dimension n−2 and, with ambient-induced coherent orientations, is Z_epsilon⊗P_n; the fundamental sphere class maps to the primitive all-ones vector in the relative group. The integral LES yields the quotient P_n/Z·1 (not the augmentation kernel) and vanishing of all other reduced groups. For t=0 permutation trace is 2fix(sigma)−1, and for t=1 it is −1, both multiplied by epsilon. The C2 invariant subspace ranks give n−1 for odd n and n for even n; S_n invariants vanish for n>=4. Independent full-cell Lefschetz sums checked 24 signed group actions at n=4..7. The universal statement uses the exact cellular proof and finite-group averaging over Q, not numerical extrapolation.
